title: Zephyr: LLSec encode/decode
description: LLSec byte encoding/decoding in Zephyr. DONE
notes: 2026-08-27 read-only validation against spec/02-physical-link.md §4.2 and canonical link_frame_signed_modes.json: address-mode bits 0-1, MIC-selector bits 2-4 (0/1 accepted; 2-7 rejected), E bit 6 rejection, and S bit 5 MIC sizing exist in Zephyr frame.c. Full LLSec acceptance is nevertheless blocked by SI/SenderID: current C defines bit7 as reserved, rejects canonical signed LLSec bytes 0xA0|mode (e.g. vector 0xA6), accepts and emits noncanonical S-only 0x20|mode, never parses/writes the required 8-byte signer EUI-64, and production lichen_link_tx.c passes NULL signer. Host frame ctest passed 1/1, but its signed positives are explicitly stale: tests/frame/main.c expects signer_iid_present=false and therefore cannot establish spec parity. Shared frame sources/tests are actively conflicted and were kept read-only. Added exact blocker project-LICHEN-worker6-l1qw.1.5.4.3 (current spec requires 8-byte EUI-64 despite stale 10-byte bead wording); no separate signature dependency is needed because Python/Rust LLSec beads .1/.2 and canonical vector bead .4.5 are already closed.
